editorial:
Imagine waking up after a terrible accident and realizing you have lost both of your hands. That is the nightmare Boyd Grayson is living in. His mother loves him and will do anything to fix his life, so she brings in some cutting-edge tech to give him new limbs. It sounds like a miracle at first, but the vibe shifts quickly from a family drama to a total nightmare. You will feel for Boyd as he tries to adjust to his new body, but you will also feel a growing sense of dread as you realize these robotic hands might have a mind of their own.

The acting is top-notch and makes the scary parts feel way more real. While the middle of the movie slows down a bit, the final act is a wild ride with twists you won't see coming. If you love stories about technology gone wrong, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the tech was actually powered by spirits from the manor. The robotic hands take full control of Boyd, turning him into a puppet for the ghosts. Boyd tries to fight back, but his mother accidentally helps the spirits win by trying to reboot the system. It ends with Boyd trapped in his own body while the spirits use him to hunt the rest of the family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary movies about cursed objects and creepy houses.
